name: CrewAI
what: A Python framework for multi-agent automation. Crews are teams of role-based agents that work together on a task; Flows are event-driven workflows with state and branching that can call crews. The CLI scaffolds projects, which are JSON-first by default. MIT licensed.
who: Builders who want to model a task as a team of specialized agents (researcher, writer, reviewer) and run it from the command line.

setup.text: Needs Python 3.10 to 3.13 and uv. Install the CLI:

setup.code:
crewai create crew my-crew
cd my-crew

setup.text: Put your model provider API key in .env, then install and run:

prompts: Create a CrewAI crew with a researcher and a writer that produces a weekly AI tools roundup.
Add a reviewer agent to this crew that checks every claim has a source.
Convert this crew into a Flow that only runs the writer if research found results.
